I need to scroll down my inbox quite far, but it shouldn’t be auto deleted yet.
Ah! Found it!
His email address was bigdaddyhurt1177@gooblygook.ic…
This guy… He probably meant to write gobbledygook, but he’s too stupid to write it correctly. 
Wait a minute! He wrote in his last message that he would delete his email ‘for safety reasons’.
I have no way of contacting him…
Hmmm... What could I do...
I know! Next time I order something from his website I'm going to add something to get his attention in the "Extra Notes".
Hmm... I should keep it pretty cryptic so if anyone else sees it they wouldn't know what I meant. I don't know if he is completely in charge of this website.
"I would like to talk about selling bot parts" would instantly put me on some sort of a watchlist for sure.
How about... "Can this order be personally packaged by H?" this should be subtle enough. Maybe, he will notice the "H" stands for hurt in "bigdaddyhurt"
Let's do that the next time I order something.
